items.t: Death wobble front-end shake
items.job: Replace front track bar and re-torque steering joints
items.note: Parts: aftermarket adjustable front track bars at Quadratec ($161.99-$305). Labor: about 1 hour install per ExtremeTerrain. YourMechanic: about $296 average for a Gladiator track bar job. Alignment is extra, and cost rises if tie rods, the drag link or ball joints are also worn.

items.t: Wandering, loose steering at highway speeds (TSB)
items.job: Replace steering gear, update power steering software and align
items.note: Parts: genuine Mopar Gladiator steering gear 68551689AE at $496-$498 online (MSRP $1,120, plus a $75 core). Labor: 1.9 hours in Jeep bulletins 08-074-20 and 08-003-21, including the software update and alignment, plus 0.2 hours on EcoDiesel trucks. Trucks still under warranty get this free.

items.t: Rubicon sway bar disconnect stops working
items.job: Replace front disconnecting sway bar assembly
items.note: Parts: Mopar front disconnect sway bar assembly at Quadratec ($1,991.99); install rated 2-3 hours. Many failures are fixed for far less by cleaning or repairing the actuator connector, so ask for that check first.

items.t: Check engine light from torque converter clutch code (TSB)
items.note: Labor: 0.2 hours in Jeep bulletins 21-023-25 and 21-019-25. Free if the truck is under warranty. If the transmission is already damaged, the repair costs much more.

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor heater codes (TSB)
items.note: Labor: 0.3 hours in Jeep bulletin 18-065-24. Free under warranty. If the codes return, an oxygen sensor may also need replacing, which costs more.

items.t: Uconnect screen glitches and "Uconnect Box Error" (TSBs)
items.note: Labor: 0.5 hours for a one-step USB radio update, 1.4 hours for a two-step update in Jeep bulletin 08-033-25. Over-the-air updates are free and need no shop visit.

items.t: Misfire and ticking from worn rocker arms or camshaft
items.note: Owner-reported range $1,500-$4,500. Plug and coil misfires cost far less (about $600).
